tasks.title: Make a cup of tea
steps: Put a tea bag in the cup
Pour the boiling water into the cup

tasks.title: Post a letter
steps: Fold it and put it in the envelope
Write the address on the front
Stick a stamp in the corner
Drop it in the post box

tasks.title: Make toast
steps: Take two slices of bread from the bag
Put the bread in the toaster
Wait for the toast to pop up
Put the toast on a plate

tasks.title: Plant a seed
steps: Make a small hole in the soil
Drop the seed into the hole
Put the pot by a sunny window

tasks.title: Wash your hands
steps: Dry your hands on a towel

tasks.title: Take the bus
steps: Show your ticket to the driver
Sit down and ring the bell before your stop

tasks.title: Make a phone call
steps: Find the number in your address book
Wait for the other person to answer

tasks.title: Do the laundry
steps: Sort the clothes into lights and darks
Put one pile in the washing machine
Take the clothes out when it stops
Hang the clothes up to dry
